question: What gives life to the consecration of the ladle and spoon?
premises: The ladle and spoon are to be worshipped as Shiva and Shakti.
Their consecration is performed in that way.
No other life of consecration exists apart from seeing the principle.
inference: The consecration of the ritual implements lives only in the direct recognition of their Shiva-Shakti principle.
plain_english: They are to be worshipped as Shiva and Shakti. Thus is their consecration performed. Apart from seeing that principle, consecration has no other life.
